cards.title: Add Two Numbers
cards.task_requirements: Given two nonempty linked lists representing nonnegative integers in reverse digit order, add the numbers and return the result as a linked list.
cards.reference_diagnosis: Stops the loop when both lists run out and drops a leftover carry, so inputs like 5 + 5 return [0] instead of [0, 1].

cards.conceptual_explanation_anchor: The carry records a digit that may remain after the input nodes are exhausted.

cards.title: Valid Sudoku
cards.task_requirements: Determine whether a partially filled 9-by-9 Sudoku board is valid according to row, column, and 3-by-3 box constraints.
cards.reference_diagnosis: Computes the box index as r // 3 + c // 3 instead of (r // 3) * 3 + c // 3, so different boxes share an index and valid boards are rejected.

cards.conceptual_explanation_anchor: Distinct boxes must receive distinct identifiers; adding their coordinates can collide.
cards.exact_repair_anchor: Use (r // 3) * 3 + c // 3, or the pair (r // 3, c // 3).
